Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 138. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 40 Ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 Reaction when you would take
damage from a ki attack or ki technique or when you
use a defensive manuever
Range: self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Omni
The user concentrates their aura into a palpable wall
of force. As a reaction you gain resistance against 1 ki
attack or technique that targets or effects you.
